an5.50:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā nārado pātaliputte viharati kukkuṭārāme.
an5.50:1.2: tena kho pana samayena muṇḍassa rañño bhaddā devī kālakatā hoti piyā manāpā
an5.50:1.3: so bhaddāya deviyā kālakatāya piyāya manāpāya neva nhāyati na vilimpati na bhattaṃ bhuñjati na kammantaṃ payojeti
an5.50:1.5: athakho muṇḍo rājā piyakaṃ sokārakkhaṃ āmantesi
an5.50:1.6: tenahi samma piyaka bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ ayasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā ayasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjatha yathā mayaṃ bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmāti
an5.50:1.7: evaṃ devāti kho piyako sokārakkho muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ ayasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā ayasāya doṇiyā paṭikujji
an5.50:2.2: imassa kho muṇḍassa rañño bhaddā devī kālakatā piyā manāpā
an5.50:2.3: so bhaddāya deviyā kālakatāya piyāya manāpāya neva nhāyati na vilimpati na bhattaṃ bhuñjati na kammantaṃ payojeti
an5.50:2.5: kaṃ nu kho muṇḍo rājā samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā payirupāseyya yassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyāti.
an5.50:3.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā nārado pātaliputte viharati kukkuṭārāme
an5.50:3.3: taṃ kho panāyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
an5.50:3.4: paṇḍito byatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāṇo vuḍḍho ceva arahā ca
an5.50:3.5: yannūna muṇḍo rājā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ payirupāseyya appeva nāma muṇḍo rājā āyasmato nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyāti
an5.50:4.1: athakho piyako sokārakkho yena muṇḍo rājā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etadavoca
an5.50:4.2: ayaṃ kho deva āyasmā nārado pātaliputte viharati kukkuṭārāme
an5.50:4.3: taṃ kho panāyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
an5.50:4.4: paṇḍito byatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāṇo vuḍḍho ceva arahā ca
an5.50:4.5: yadi pana devo āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ payirupāseyya appeva nāma devo āyasmato nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyāti.
an5.50:4.6: tenahi samma piyaka āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ paṭivedehi
an5.50:4.7: kathañhi nāma mādiso samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā vijite vasantaṃ pubbe appaṭisaṃviditaṃ upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti
an5.50:4.8: evaṃ devāti kho piyako sokārakkho muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā yenāyasmā nārado tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho piyako sokārakkho āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ etadavoca
an5.50:5.1: imassa bhante muṇḍassa rañño bhaddā devī kālakatā piyā manāpā
an5.50:5.2: so bhaddāya deviyā kālakatāya piyāya manāpāya neva nhāyati na vilimpati na bhattaṃ bhuñjati na kammantaṃ payojeti
an5.50:5.4: sādhu bhante āyasmā nārado muṇḍassa rañño tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā muṇḍo rājā āyasmato nāradassa dhammaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pajaheyyāti
an5.50:5.5: yassadāni piyaka muṇḍo rājā kālaṃ maññatīti
an5.50:6.1: athakho piyako sokārakkho uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena muṇḍo rājā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etadavoca
an5.50:6.4: tenahi samma piyaka bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpehīti
an5.50:6.5: evaṃ devāti kho piyako sokārakkho muṇḍassa rañño paṭissutvā bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni yojāpetvā muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ etadavoca
an5.50:6.6: yuttāni kho te deva bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni.
an5.50:7.1: athakho muṇḍo rājā bhadrāni bhadrāni yānāni abhirūhitvā bhadrehi bhadrehi yānehi yena kukkuṭārāmo tena pāyāsi mahaccarājānubhāvena āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ dassanāya
an5.50:7.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikova ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
an5.50:7.3: athakho muṇḍo rājā yena āyasmā nārado tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho muṇḍaṃ rājānaṃ āyasmā nārado etadavoca
an5.50:8.1: pañcimāni mahārāja alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ
an5.50:8.3: jarādhammaṃ mājirīti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ
an5.50:8.4: byādhidhammaṃ mā byādhiyīti … maraṇadhammaṃ mā miyyīti … khayadhammaṃ mā khiyīti … nassanadhammaṃ mā nassīti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ
an5.50:9.2: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe na iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.50:9.3: na kho mayhevekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati
an5.50:9.4: ahañceva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ bhattampi me nacchādeyya kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ amittāpi attamanā assu mittāpi dummanā assūti
an5.50:9.5: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷī kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati
an5.50:9.7: assutavā puthujjano viddho savisena sokasallena attānaññeva paritāpeti.
an5.50:10.1: puna caparaṃ mahārāja assutavato puthujjanassa byādhidhammaṃ byādhiyati … maraṇadhammaṃ miyyati … khayadhammaṃ khiyati … nassanadhammaṃ nassati
an5.50:10.2: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na iti paṭisañcikkhati
an5.50:10.3: na kho mayhevekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati
an5.50:10.4: ahañceva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ bhattampi me nacchādeyya kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ amittāpi attamanā assu mittāpi dummanā assūti
an5.50:10.5: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷī kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati
an5.50:10.7: assutavā puthujjano viddho savisena sokasallena attānaññeva paritāpeti.
an5.50:11.1: sutavato ca kho mahārāja ariyasāvakassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati
an5.50:11.3: na kho mayhevekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati
an5.50:11.4: ahañceva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ bhattampi me nacchādeyya kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ amittāpi attamanā assu mittāpi dummanā assūti
an5.50:11.5: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷī kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati
an5.50:11.7: sutavā ariyasāvako abbuhi savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaññeva paritāpeti
an5.50:12.1: puna caparaṃ mahārāja sutavato ariyasāvakassa byādhidhammaṃ byādhiyati … maraṇadhammaṃ miyyati … khayadhammaṃ khiyati … nassanadhammaṃ nassati
an5.50:12.3: na kho mayhevekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati
an5.50:12.4: ahañceva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ kilameyyaṃ parideveyyaṃ urattāḷī kandeyyaṃ sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ bhattampi me nacchādeyya kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ amittāpi attamanā assu mittāpi dummanā assūti
an5.50:12.5: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷī kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati
an5.50:12.7: sutavā ariyasāvako abbuhi savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaññeva paritāpeti
an5.50:13.1: imāni kho mahārāja pañca alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasminti.
an5.50:17.2: mayā vā aññena vā esa attho
an5.50:18.1: evaṃ vutte muṇḍo rājā āyasmantaṃ nāradaṃ etadavoca
an5.50:18.5: taggha bhante sokasallaharaṇo imaṃ hi me bhante dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā sokasallaṃ pahīnanti.
an5.50:19.1: athakho muṇḍo rājā piyakaṃ sokārakkhaṃ āmantesi
an5.50:19.2: tenahi samma piyaka bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ jhāpetha thūpañcassā karotha.
an5.50:19.3: ajjataggedāni mayaṃ nhāyissāma ceva vilimpissāma bhattaṃ bhuñjissāma kammante ca payojessāmāti.
